title: Damaged, Probably Used, and Possibly Counterfeit
text: The finish on the toes and heels of both shoes was damaged. The damage had been painted over. Not a very good job was done of painting. One shoe had a couple of pin-prick surface holes down the side. And the shoes didn't even come in a shoe box! The shoes were either used, damaged, returned, then sold as new, or else they were significantly damaged in manufacturing and then poorly repaired, and, if so, are probably counterfeit, I don't think Ecco would do that. I have noticed many reviews stating that the quality of Ecco products took a nose dive when their manufacture moved to that country that has so many problems, you-know-where. These shoes were so bad that I returned them, and they were made in that place. Too bad I can't give a rating of a negative number of stars.
label: negative
